The present writ petition has been filed for direction to quash the Land Acquisition Notification bearing No.15/DLA Patna (Pu) 44/10-702/Ra issued under the emergency provisions of the Land Acquisition Act leading to the institution of the Land Acquisition Case No.16 of 2011-12 and on the ground that the said acquisition was made for construction of an over-bridge near the Patna Saheb Railway Station as without sanction it sought to acquire the petitioner's land/building with further speaking for taking possession over the petitioner's land situated in Municipal Survey Plot No.997 situated in Mouja Chowk Shikarpur, Patna City within Municipal Ward No.29 without following the mandate Patna High Court CWJC No.11035 of 2015(5) dt.11-09-2023 of law particularly Section 9 and Section 17(3-A)(a) of the Land Acquisition Act.
